# PRAXEL · MU COURSE 1 · PRE-READS MASTER LIST

*v1.0 · Companion to the COT. For the LMS: these populate each session hub's "read before class" materials as external links.*

## Session 1 · Data privacy law (the Day 1 read)

The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) is India's core law on how personal data must be collected, used, and protected. Its implementing Rules were notified in November 2025, so they are live, not proposed.

- Required, plain-English overview: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 — Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_Personal_Data_Protection_Act,_2023)
- Required, what changed with the Rules: India's DPDP Rules 2025 practical guide — Scrut.io (https://www.scrut.io/post/dpdp-rules)
- Optional, primary source: Government notifies DPDP Rules, 2025 — PIB (https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2190014&reg=3&lang=2)
